sents.zh: 从前有一只猫和一只老鼠，住在一个房子里。
sents.en: Once there were a cat and a mouse, living in one house.

sents.zh: 房子很大，里面有很多东西。
sents.en: The house was large, with many things in it.
The cat wanted to eat the mouse every day.
But the mouse ran extremely fast.

sents.zh: 有一天早上，猫在门后面等着。
sents.en: One morning the cat waited behind the door.

sents.zh: 老鼠出来的时候，猫就跳了出去。
sents.en: When the mouse came out, the cat sprang.

sents.zh: 老鼠一看，马上向外面跑。
sents.en: The moment the mouse saw it, it ran outside.

sents.zh: 它跑过田，跑过河，一直跑到山上。
sents.en: It ran across the fields, across the river, all the way up the mountain.

sents.zh: 因为山路太长，所以猫跑不动了。
sents.en: Because the mountain path was so long, the cat could run no further.

sents.zh: 猫坐在山下，看着上面，一句话也不说。
sents.en: The cat sat at the foot of the mountain, looking up, saying nothing.

sents.zh: 老鼠到了山上，发现那里很好。
sents.en: The mouse reached the top and found it was a fine place.

sents.zh: 山上有水，有花，还有很多好吃的东西。
sents.en: There was water, flowers, and much good food.
And there was no cat there.

sents.zh: 所以老鼠决定住在山上，不下去了。
sents.en: So the mouse decided to live there and not go down.

sents.zh: 猫等了很久，最后自己回家了。
sents.en: The cat waited a long time, and in the end went home alone.
